official_sources.title: Environment Agency Survey Data Catalogue FAQ — vertical accuracy of LiDAR data
official_sources.finding: EA specifications require absolute height error below ±15 cm RMSE and expect relative/random height error no more than ±5 cm; the survey-specific Ground Truth result must be checked for a particular survey.
official_sources.limitation: Programme thresholds are not the measured uncertainty of a parcel extrema pair; the contributing survey result must be bound.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official public authority page; applicable publisher terms/Open Government Licence where stated

official_sources.title: Environment Agency Survey Data Catalogue FAQ — LiDAR point density
official_sources.finding: Average point density depends on target surface-model resolution: at least 1 ppsqm for 1 m DSM, 4 ppsqm for 50 cm and 16 ppsqm for 25 cm; DTM ground-return density under vegetation can be lower and point clouds are irregular rather than regular grids.
official_sources.limitation: DSM point-density minima do not guarantee DTM ground support inside a parcel or at its extrema.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official public authority page; applicable publisher terms/Open Government Licence where stated

official_sources.title: Environment Agency LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles
official_sources.finding: Survey-specific DSM tiles are available at 25 cm, 50 cm, 1 m and 2 m, in metres on the OS Grid and ODN; metadata identifies survey dates, resolution, transformation and geoidal model, with ±15 cm RMSE vertical-accuracy context.
official_sources.limitation: DSM includes surface objects and cannot substitute for DTM when ground terrain is required.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official public authority page; applicable publisher terms/Open Government Licence where stated

official_sources.title: Environment Agency LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud
official_sources.finding: The point-cloud archive contains x,y,z points and attributes; timestamped DSM/DTM rasters are derived from point clouds, but historic archiving means a matching point cloud may not exist for every surface model. Coverage metadata records flown dates and average point density.
official_sources.limitation: Classified ground points do not necessarily match the manually edited final DTM, so point-cloud extrema cannot be assumed identical to DTM extrema.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official public authority page; applicable publisher terms/Open Government Licence where stated

official_sources.title: Environment Agency National LIDAR Programme
official_sources.finding: England was divided into 302 survey blocks for Phase 1 capture between 2017 and 2023; repeat captures use incrementing phase numbers and coverage metadata is published in EPSG:27700.
official_sources.limitation: A later phase is not automatically the correct source for the target; target geometry must intersect the survey metadata and selected product lineage.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official public authority page; applicable publisher terms/Open Government Licence where stated

official_sources.title: Environment Agency LIDAR Composite First Return DSM - 1m
official_sources.finding: The first-return DSM uses the first or only pulse, includes surface objects, and merges National LIDAR Programme surveys with feathering across overlaps; survey metadata identifies contributing survey lineage.
official_sources.limitation: First-return DSM is not a terrain model and overlap feathering can alter local surface extrema; it is only a cross-check for ground-height work.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official public authority page; applicable publisher terms/Open Government Licence where stated

official_sources.title: Ordnance Survey OS Net & GNSS FAQ
official_sources.finding: OS explains that GNSS/WGS84-ETRS89 coordinates differ from OSGB36 National Grid and ODN heights; OSTN15/OSGM15 provides the transformation, and corrected GNSS positioning can achieve centimetre-scale positional accuracy depending on equipment and environment.
official_sources.limitation: Centimetre GNSS positioning capability does not equal LIDAR elevation accuracy and must be kept as a separate checkpoint/source uncertainty component.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official public authority page; applicable publisher terms/Open Government Licence where stated

official_sources.title: Ordnance Survey Grid InQuest II transformation software
official_sources.finding: Grid InQuest II implements transformations between ETRS89/WGS84 and OSGB36 using OSTN15/OSGM15 and supports batch conversion; OSTN15/OSGM15 replaced OSTN02/OSGM02 in 2016.
official_sources.limitation: Transformation software identity and model version must be recorded; mixing historical and current models can introduce systematic vertical-reference inconsistencies.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official public authority page; applicable publisher terms/Open Government Licence where stated

official_sources.title: Ordnance Survey datum height differences
official_sources.finding: OS documents that Liverpool and Newlyn datum differences vary spatially across Britain and may vary between kilometre squares; ODN is based on Newlyn mean sea level and Fundamental Bench Marks.
official_sources.limitation: Legacy-datum elevations cannot be combined with ODN elevations using one constant offset; the exact datum and transformation path must be known.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official public authority page; applicable publisher terms/Open Government Licence where stated

official_sources.title: Ordnance Survey geodesy and positioning reference
official_sources.finding: OS identifies OS Net as the ETRS89 realisation, OSTN15 as the OSGB36 National Grid transformation, the Fundamental Bench Mark network as defining ODN on mainland GB, and OSGM15 as the geoid/height corrector surface used to realise ODN from ETRS89.
official_sources.limitation: Reference-system definitions do not prove a specific transformation execution; per-value provenance and model version remain mandatory.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official public authority page; applicable publisher terms/Open Government Licence where stated
